headline: Canada pledges $400 million for forest protection following bilateral talks with Brazil
summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney announced a $400 million commitment to support international forest protection following a bilateral meeting with Brazilian President Lula da Silva in Ottawa.
why: Multilateral climate commitments support green finance projects and international carbon offsetting programs.

impacts.why: The $400 million pledge allocates federal funds toward global environmental initiatives.
